title: Unit skylights.
officialText:
Unit skylights shall be tested and labeled as complying with AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440 Voluntary
Performance Specification for Windows, Skylights and Glass. The label shall state the name of the manufacturer, the approved
agency, the product designation and the performance grade rating as specified in AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440. If the product
manufacturer has chosen to have the performance grade of the skylight rated separately for positive and negative design pressure,
then the label shall state both performance grade ratings as specified in AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440 and the skylight shall
comply with Section 2405.5.2. If the skylight is not rated separately for positive and negative pressure, then the performance grade
rating shown on the label shall be the performance grade rating determined in accordance with AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/I.S.2/A440
for both positive and negative design pressure, and the skylight shall conform to Section 2405.5.1.
